title: Video editing
notFoundBody: This video does not exist or was deleted.
noMatchHint: Link a match so this coding fills its report and counts in the season.

hosted.label: Hosted on {{app}}
hosted.error: The hosted video does not load. Check the connection, then try again.

file.pickHint: Choose the file on this device, film now with the camera, or paste a YouTube or Facebook link.
file.repickHint: To save memory, {{app}} does not keep the video. Open the same file again to find your codes and clips at the right moments.
file.name: File: {{name}}
file.notVideo: This file is not a video.
file.mismatch: This file is called « {{got}} », the video expects « {{want}} ». Codes and clips will be placed on this file.
file.error: This browser cannot play this file.

link.errorBody: Check that it is unlisted or public on YouTube, public on Facebook, and that embedding is allowed. A private video does not show.

zoom.followHint: Following the ball automatically needs the ball to be tracked on every frame: it is on the roadmap, not in the app yet. For now, zoom with the wheel, two fingers or the buttons, and drag the picture.

useful.hint: Plays only the moments around coded actions and clips: stretches of more than 12 seconds without any code are skipped. The app does not detect stoppages by itself.
useful.on: Useful time: {{kept}} kept out of {{total}}. Stretches of more than 12 s without a code are skipped, stoppages are not detected by themselves.

pad.hint: The code lands at the moment the video shows.
pad.hintMatch: Every code goes into the match report, with its moment.
pad.needReplace: This match already has live coding: replace it first.

sp.title: Set pieces
sp.hint: Counted apart, never in the Index

place.title: Where the action happened
place.idle: Code an action: it is placed here.
place.idleBody: After each code: tap the spot on the pitch, then the player's number. All of it is optional.
place.them: Opponent action: just tap the spot on the pitch.
place.pitch: Mini-pitch: tap where the action happened. Our attack goes left to right.
place.onlyPitch: Only the players on the pitch
place.inferred: Substitutions worked out from the codes
place.keys: Keyboard: type the shirt number, Enter to finish, Esc to skip. Letters code the next action.
place.keysThem: Enter or Esc to finish. The codes keep working.

coded.title: Coded actions
coded.empty: No coded action yet. Play the video and tap a code at the right moment.

indice.title: Njangi Index
indice.hint: Worked out from this video's codes.
indice.match: Worked out from the codes placed on the video: it is the Index of the match report.

live.title_one: This match already has one code entered live.
live.title_other: This match already has {{count}} codes entered live.
live.body: A match has one coding. Coding on the video replaces the live coding, and every action can be watched again.
live.replaceBody: The codes entered live for this match will be deleted. You will code the match again on its video, action by action, each at its moment. The match score does not change.
live.replaced: Live coding deleted: now code on the video.

clips.title: Clips
clips.handles: Drag the gold handles on the timeline, to a tenth of a second in the detail.
clips.titlePh: E.g. the build-up with three, all the way to the goal
clips.notePh: What to watch in this clip
clips.autoHint: Automatic clip: it follows the coded action and cannot be edited. Duplicate it to edit it.
clips.empty: No clip yet. Tap « Create a clip », or code a shot or a goal: its clip makes itself.
clips.copyLink: Copy the link to the moment
clips.linkCopied: Link copied: it opens the video at the start of the clip.
clips.linkCopiedFb: Link copied. Facebook opens the video at the start: go to {{t}}.
clips.copyFail: Copying did not work in this browser.

pl.title: Video sessions
pl.hint: A session plays clips one after the other for the players, full screen, on a TV or a phone.
pl.empty: No session yet. Create one, then add clips to it.
pl.name: Session title
pl.notePh: The message to get across, in one or two sentences
pl.order: Clip order (drag, or use the arrows)
pl.noClips: No clip in this session yet.
pl.deleteAsk: Delete this session? The clips stay.

help.circle: Drag from the centre to circle.
help.spotlight: Tap a player to light him up, drag to widen the ring.
help.rect: Drag to place a rectangular zone.
help.poly: Tap each corner of the zone, then the first point, a double tap or Enter to close it.
help.connect: Tap the players one after the other to link them, then a double tap or Enter.
help.text: Tap where the text goes, type, then Enter.

draw.toDraft: The image will go on the clip being made.
draw.toClip: The image will go on the clip « {{name}} ».
draw.toAuto: The automatic clip « {{name}} » will be duplicated with the image.
draw.toCoded: The image will go with the action {{name}} at {{t}}.
draw.toNote: The image will be kept as a note at this moment.
draw.fail: The image could not be saved.
draw.savedDraft: Image added to the clip being made

image.alt: Video frame at {{t}}, with the drawing

export.title: Export the clip
export.csvBody: For a spreadsheet: moment, code, player, receiver, place on the pitch.
export.jsonBody: All the analysis data, with the Njangi Index.
export.clipsBody: The clips and the sessions, with their moments and players.
export.videoHint: For a video file of one clip, open the Clips tab, tap the clip, then « Export the clip ».
export.realtime: The clip plays once to be recorded: allow its length plus a few seconds. Keep this page open.
export.done: Video ready: {{name}} ({{mb}} MB). The download has started.
export.fail: This browser could not make the video. Try an up-to-date Chrome or Edge.
export.noSound: It opens on the title, then the drawn image held for three seconds. Sound is not included.

keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.sp: Corner, free kick, penalty, throw-in, goal kick (us)
keys.place: Place on the pitch (on or off)
keys.zoom: Zoom in, zoom out, wide view
keys.placeHint: While placing is open, digits type the shirt number, Enter finishes and Esc skips.

show.emptyBody: Add clips to the session in the studio, then start it again.
show.keys: Keyboard: Space to pause, arrows for the previous or next clip, F for full screen, Esc to leave.
show.freeze: The coach's image, the video carries on in a moment.
show.needFileBody: The video is on this device: choose the file to start the session.
